diffs.diff: maximum supply: part 5.5 V, datasheet reading 5 V
diffs.evidence: The model is the GY-21 module (on-board 3.3 V regulator + MOSFET level shifters), not the bare chip. The vendor's GY-21 module page lists under Technical Specifications / Maximum Ratings: 'Vcc Range 3.3 to 5.5V' and says 'The backside of the module mounts a 3.3V regulator and level shifting MOSFET transistors to make the module compatible with both 3.3V and 5V MCUs.' The 5 V in the second reading is the nominal 5 V-MCU figure ('Connect Vin to 3-5VDC to match MCU'), not a limit. The Si7021-A20 chip datasheet itself gives VDD 1.9-3.6 V (abs max 4.2 V), which applies only behind the regulator and gives neither 5 nor 5.5 V for VIN.
